show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: After his parents die in a tragic accident, champion bodybuilder Akhilan sinks into depression and anxiety. Stress drives him to overeating and he soon loses his fitness, fame and the respect he once commanded. As his lover turns against him, Akhilan hits rock bottom, facing humiliation and self-doubt. Refusing to give up, he accepts a daring challenge to reclaim his body and honor in just three months. Witness his powerful comeback journey in 'Mistaken Fat Man' streaming only on KukuTV.
